security_privacy_cost_impact: Closes an integrity gap in the test suite (A1-293-2, A1-294-3, Info): a git configuration of the machine running the suite (a core.hooksPath, core.fsmonitor or init.templateDir in the global or system file) no longer reaches the throwaway repositories test-kits/branch-scope.test.mjs creates, so it cannot run code there or change what the tests measure. No credential, secret, personal data, provider call or dependency change; ci.yml and every script CI runs are unchanged.
compatibility_impact: No contract changes. The scratch repositories already set their own user.name, user.email and commit.gpgsign and init with -b main, so they need nothing from the global file. The file's run time grows by the two concurrent nested reruns of the new test (see tests).
known_limitations: Only this package's file is fixed. WP-0A-CON-008's three files are its own pull request.

The system gitconfig is not exercised by a running hook: a test cannot plant it inside a temporary directory without GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM, which childEnv strips with every GIT_*. GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 is pinned by childEnv's own output only.
The pin is behavioural: a new spawn site added later without childEnv is caught only if it runs git in a way that fires one of the ten hooks; no static check over spawn calls is added.

The GIT_* pin's nested node processes and the new test's nested node processes themselves start from withoutCallerGit (no GIT_CONFIG_* set), so that each nested run measures the file's own isolation rather than an isolation inherited from the outer run.
